## Stage 2: Automated Research Agent

Give it just a product name/brand/category. The DeepSeek API autonomously searches the web (via self-hosted SearXNG) and reads real pages (HTTP fetch + HTML-to-text) to build the evidence set itself — no hand-typed facts.

Requires:
- SearXNG reachable at http://searxng:8080
- A DeepSeek API key (DEEP_SEEK_API_KEY env var passed to the n8n container). Model: deepseek-flash.
